mentions.name: Epub Translator
mentions.description: This tool translates EPUB ebooks, dealing with the fragmented epub format through custom parsing to support the many varying epub file structures.
mentions.problem: The epub format is highly fragmented, requiring a lot of custom parsing to handle.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Epub Translator https://epubtranslator.net. The epub format is so fragmented. A lot of custom parsing we need to deal with.
mentions.author: xiaoape
